# Copilot Instructions

`AGENTS.md` is the shared project contract and is the source of truth. Follow it for architecture, runtime, boundaries, testing, dependency decisions, and Git discipline.

Keep changes small, TypeScript-first, tested, reversible, and compatible with the modular monolith and Clean/Hexagonal Architecture. Do not introduce framework imports into domain code or implement future PostgreSQL, Prisma, MCP, events, workers, authentication, frontend, or commercial features without an explicit task.
